subject: Error in RI-CLPM when constraining standardised lagged effects

messages.author: b1227e52e7a7abad
messages.subject: Error in RI-CLPM when constraining standardised lagged effects
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am following Moulder's & Hamaker's syntax to conduct RI-CLPM on 4 variables (E, M, C and y) at 3 time points. The basic model and constraints over time model are working fine, but I'm having trouble with the R script for constraining standardised lagged effects. This is my code: 

# RI-CLPM model - constrained standardised lagged effects----
RICLPM6 <- '
  # Create between components (random intercepts)
  RI_E =~ 1*E1 + 1*E2 + 1*E3
  RI_M =~ 1*M1 + 1*M2 + 1*M3
  RI_C =~ 1*C1 + 1*C2 + 1*C3
  RIy =~ 1*y1 + 1*y2 + 1*y3
 
  # Create within-components with freely estimated factor loadings
  wE1 =~ NA*E1
  wE2 =~ NA*E2
  wE3 =~ NA*E3
  wM1 =~ NA*M1
  wM2 =~ NA*M2
  wM3 =~ NA*M3
  wC1 =~ NA*C1
  wC2 =~ NA*C2
  wC3 =~ NA*C3
  wy1 =~ NA*y1
  wy2 =~ NA*y2
  wy3 =~ NA*y3
 
  # Estimate lagged effects between within-person centered variables
  # (constrained)
  wy2 ~ a*wE1 + b*wM1 + c*wC1
  wy3 ~ a*wE2 + b*wM2 + c*wC2
 
  # Label residual covariances
  wy2 ~~ rcov2*wE2
  wy2 ~~ rcov3*wM2
  wy2 ~~ rcov4*wC2
  wy3 ~~ rcov5*wE2
  wy3 ~~ rcov6*wM2
  wy3 ~~ rcov7*wC2
 
  # Estimate correlation between within-components at first wave
  wy1 ~~ cor1*wE1
  wy1 ~~ cor2*wM1
  wy1 ~~ cor3*wC1
 
  # Estimate variance and covariance of random intercepts
  RI_E ~~ RI_E
  RIy ~~ RIy
  RIy ~~ RI_E
  RI_M ~~ RI_M
  RI_C ~~ RI_C
  RIy ~~ RI_M
  RIy ~~ RI_C
 
  # Set variances of within-components at first wave to 1
  wE1 ~~ 1*wE1
  wM1 ~~ 1*wC1
  wC1 ~~ 1*wC1
  wy1 ~~ 1*wy1
 
  # Label residual variances
  wE2 ~~ rvE2*wE2
  wM2 ~~ rvM2*wM2
  wC2 ~~ rvC2*wC2
  wy2 ~~ rvy2*wy2
  wE3 ~~ rvE3*wE3
  wM3 ~~ rvM3*wM3
  wC3 ~~ rvC3*wC3
  wy3 ~~ rvy3*wy3

  # Constrain grand means over time
  E1 + E2 + E3 ~ mx*1
  M1 + M2 + M3 ~ mz*1
  C1 + C2 + C3 ~ mc*1
  y1 + y2 + y3 ~ my*1
 
  # Compute correlations of within-components at each wave
  cor2 := a*c + b*c + a*b*cor1 + rcov2
  cor3 := a*c + b*c + a*b*cor2 + rcov3
 
  # Contrain residual variances of within-components such that variance of each
  # within-component equals 1
  rvE2 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor1)
  rvM2 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor1)
  rvC2 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor1)
  rvy2 == 1 - (c*c + d*d + 2*c*d*cor1)
  rvE3 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor2)
  rvM3 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor2)
  rvC3 == 1 - (a*a + b*b + 2*a*b*cor2)
  rvy3 == 1 - (c*c + d*d + 2*c*d*cor2)
'
RICLPM6.fit <- lavaan(RICLPM6,
                      data = dat1,
                      missing = 'ML',
                      meanstructure = T,
                      int.ov.free = T
)
summary(RICLPM6.fit, standardized = F)
summary(RICLPM6.fit, standardized = T)

And this is the error I'm getting: 
Error in lav_start_check_cov(lavpartable = lavpartable, start = START) :
  lavaan ERROR: please provide better fixed values for (co)variances;
                variables involved are: wM1 wC1

I'm not sure where wM1 and wC1 are not working; this nomenclature has been working fine for previous models. Can anyone spot where I'm making an error, please? 

Thank you in advance for your help!

Best wishes,
Wika

messages.author: f1530326ce101401
messages.subject: Re: Error in RI-CLPM when constraining standardised lagged effects
parts:
Hello,

I only had a brief look at your code, but could the problem be: wM1 ~~ 1*wC1 (to replace with wM1 ~~ 1*wM1)?

In the piece of code below:

# Set variances of within-components at first wave to 1
  wE1 ~~ 1*wE1
  wM1 ~~ 1*wC1
  wC1 ~~ 1*wC1
  wy1 ~~ 1*wy1

Best wishes,

Jasper
